set.outcome:
**GRIDS lab shipped** — 4 grid-column pairings, each a live columns() tree at core/Page/overview/columns/examples/grids/, zero console errors at 1280/1600/1920/3440.

1. [Grid → Detail](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/examples/grids/grid-detail/) — large grid of tiles opens a small detail column. Reuses columns' own native child-row list, restyled into a grid (no duplicate nav). Verdict: works, reads like a drawer not a squeeze.
2. [List → Large](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/examples/grids/list-large/) — small picker opens a large stat-grid column, Finder inverted in weight. Verdict: large earns its width only when the detail is genuinely wide.
3. [Measure at 3440](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/examples/grids/measure-3440/) — one default-width column, real measured numbers: row/column/dead-space at 1280 (1051/602px, 43%), 1920 (1677/640px, 62%), 3440 (3166/720px, 77%). Column stays readable throughout; dead space is the finding, not cramping.
4. [Flush Wall](/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/examples/grids/flush-wall/) — 0-gap 0-pad grid (negative-margin escape past `.page-column-prose`'s inset) vs gap+pad+tint. Verdict: flush wins when the grid IS the content; padded is safer near any caption/prose.

Cuts: no separate `doc/decisions.md` — the 3 non-obvious calls (native-list restyle instead of a duplicate grid, the flush margin's coupling to Page.css's 0.7em/0.9em, the root-font-size-scales-with-viewport discovery) are documented inline as code comments/prose instead. The real dev server (8091) was down the whole session — verified against a throwaway static substitute (`npx serve`, port 8092) rather than touching or restarting the real one.
